With the Phase 2a test file entirely REMOVED the lane still fails, and the victim SHIFTED to two completely different tests in different files — neither of them the ip_org test that failed in the full run. This is the textbook order-dependent event-loop flake signature and it is definitively NOT caused by Phase 2a. Note the direction: 1 failure WITH the new file vs 2 failures WITHOUT it.

attribution_evidence.domain_argument: test_ip_org_pipeline exercises ip_org ingest + a shared advisory lock on ip_org tables. It shares NO table, service, model or fixture with identity_coop. The only shared surface is the GLOBAL async_session engine that conftest reuses across event loops — the documented flake vector.
attribution_evidence.prior_baseline: The pre-EVL baseline run with the new file ignored failed two DIFFERENT tests — the victim-shifts signature of an order-dependent event-loop flake rather than a deterministic defect.
attribution_evidence.conclusion: PRE-EXISTING, NOT Phase 2a. Recorded as a known-gap, not a Phase 2a defect. Zero identity_coop tests failed in any run.
